title: Security Council Revamp: 9 to 5 Members, New Thresholds
summary: Restructures the Security Council to 5 members (Taiko Labs, L2BEAT, Aragon, Nethermind, Gustavo Gonzalez), sets the standard proposal threshold to 3/5 and the emergency proposal threshold to 4/5.
description: TBD — full rationale, matching PROPOSAL-0020.md in taiko-mono (packages/protocol/script/layer1/proposals/Proposal0020.md). Removes Chainbound, Halborn, Drew Van der Werff, Toni Wahrstätter and Gattaca; retains Taiko Labs, L2BEAT, Aragon and Nethermind; adds Gustavo Gonzalez as an independent member (seat 0xAC5898b0FFFd23F4Ef09F0E50Fa1bC4896eF7163). Lowers SignerList minSignerListLength from 8 to 4, standard multisig minApprovals from 5 to 3, emergency multisig minApprovals from 7 to 4. All other settings (10-day veto duration, 14-day expiration) unchanged.
